<thought>We have a molecular ion at m/z 121.05 with an M+1 peak (~8 % of the base), indicating roughly eight carbons. The most plausible formula fitting this mass and isotopic pattern is C₈H₉O (exact monoisotopic mass 121.0653 Da). To confirm the structure, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample and compare the observed chemical‑shift pattern with typical values for possible C₈H₉O isomers (e.g., phenyl‑acetaldehyde, 2‑phenyl‑ethanol, benzyl‑acetate, etc.).</thought>
<final_answer>Awaiting further spectral data to propose the exact SMILES.</final_answer>
